scope: CVG-002B2B bounded fail-closed barrier for legacy PIX confirmation settlement

criteria.description: The legacy PIX consumer can fabricate an amount-zero transaction or settle an attempt-linked transaction outside B1, and the bounded owner, resources and exclusions are recorded.
criteria.limitations: The risk is established by repository evidence; no implementation or runtime proof is claimed at gate creation.

criteria.description: The smallest safe boundary is the shared payment event consumer: require an authoritative no-attempt transaction, validate all tenant and billing invariants before mutation, and preserve the dedicated signed provider flow.
criteria.limitations: The dedicated pix.payment.confirmed.v1 worker path remains outside this slice and must retain its existing contract.

criteria.description: Focused RED/GREEN consumer tests and event-bus adapter assertions can prove no create/no update/no settlement on invalid legacy events while retaining valid legacy settlement.
criteria.limitations: Fresh RED/GREEN execution, package regressions, independent review and bounded reconciliation are required before verification.

gaps: The rejecting RED tests, minimal fail-closed implementation, runtime/database proof and independent review are not complete at gate creation.
conditions: Do not remove the legacy consumer or change the dedicated pix.payment.confirmed.v1 protocol; reject only unsupported or incoherent legacy confirmations before writes.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-002B2B bounded legacy PIX settlement barrier
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, focused consumer/event-bus tests and disposable PostgreSQL verification of fail-closed legacy PIX settlement. Preserve valid no-attempt legacy compatibility and the dedicated B1 provider flow. Exclude schema, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing the B1 primitive, dedicated pix.payment.confirmed.v1 worker flow, removing legacy compatibility, altering schema or operating target/production.

revalidation_triggers: Changes to PixTransactionRecord.paymentAttemptId or its repository semantics
Changes to payment.pix.confirmed producers or PaymentsEventHandlers registration
Changes to the dedicated pix.payment.confirmed.v1 settlement worker
Any provider, target, production, deployment or release operation
next_action: Write and run the intentional RED consumer contract, then implement the minimal authoritative/no-attempt and pre-write validation barrier.
